description: This class defines a 'SingleComparisonNode' which models a comparison operation (like equals, not equals, greater than, etc.) as part of a predicate AST in the Eclipse Ditto RQL (Resource Query Language) parser. It includes an enum for comparison types and methods to accept visitors.

classes.name: SingleComparisonNode
classes.description: Represents a comparison operation within the predicate AST, such as EQ, NE, GT, etc. It holds the comparison type, property, and value, and implements an accept method for visitors.

classes.name: SingleComparisonNode.Type
classes.description: Enumeration of comparison types: EQ, NE, GT, GE, LT, LE, LIKE.

methods.name: SingleComparisonNode
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the comparison node with a type, property, and value.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a PredicateVisitor, allowing the visitor to perform operations on this node.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the comparison type.
